address: Concourse, Ritz-Carlton Residences, 105 Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, 50450, Malaysia
bio: The entrance to Hide is tucked away in a secluded corner among some paintings. The interior has a trendy feel, with its U-shaped marble counter overlooking the open kitchen. The young head chef once worked in the US, and his season-driven tasting menu embodies the multicultural influences in Malaysian cuisine. Local produce and seafood are prominently used in dishes such as lobster mapo with Sichuan pepper oil, and puff pastry with kaya mousse....
